scholarships.title: ARES Scholarships - Bourses de formations internationales (scholarships for study in Belgium)

existing.description: ARES, the Walloon agency for international cooperation and education, awards scholarships so that professionals from its partner countries can study in Wallonia, in institutions of the Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles. The 'bourses de formations internationales' cover a one-year bachelor of specialisation (bachelier de spécialisation), a specialised master's degree (master de spécialisation) or a short continuing-education course of up to six months, with study programmes that address development-related issues. The scholarship is aimed at people who are permanent residents and working in one of ARES's partner countries and who already hold a higher education diploma. For the 2026-2027 call 200 scholarships were available; for 2027-2028 the call offered one bachelor of specialisation, eight specialised master's degrees and one continuing-education certificate. Applications are submitted through the GIRAF platform and the selection is run by a jury for each programme.
existing.notes: Applying to an ARES scholarship is free of charge: "Postuler à une bourse de l'ARES est gratuit. L'ARES ne demande donc aucun frais à quelque étape du processus de candidature ou de sélection que ce soit." ARES warns against anyone claiming to act for ARES and requesting payment by email; report such cases to bourses-cooperation@ares-ac.be. Award holders are expected to return to their country of origin or another country and to apply the training acquired in Belgium to development, for example through a work contract or a formal commitment, with a multiplier effect. ARES guarantees the possibility of deferring the scholarship in case of pregnancy.
existing.application_period: Annual cycle: the call opens in early August and applications close in mid-September, with preselection and selection running from October to May and results in June
existing.deadline_display: For the 2027-2028 call, applications had to be submitted through the GIRAF platform by Friday 18 September 2026 at 12h (Belgian time). The call is now closed and the next call is announced for August 2027.
existing.program_type: Government scholarship of the Walloon government, administered by ARES
